textures.scope: Original generated albedo; approximate derived normal and roughness, not measured material data

skin: One rigid bone influence per vertex; bone shape remains rigid during joint motion
foot_contacts: Visible closed calcaneus and metatarsal pieces with small plantar facets, no invisible contact shoe
gait: Three local cycles,90Hz keys, inverse-kinematic ankles and a separate declared piece-volume support proxy
anatomical_scope: Original humanlike undead game adaptation; component count and rig joints are not a claim to model exactly206 anatomical bones
scope: Première adaptation originale encore stylisée. Crâne, bassin et proportions des os restent à affiner ; coutures de projection et intersections articulaires non exhaustivement qualifiées. Sol plat uniquement : pas de photoréalisme final, forces/friction, équilibre physique, terrain, attaque, mort, équipement, monde principal, serveur/réseau, VR ou FPS qualifiés.
